versions.changelog:
- Added English metadata fields (name_en, description_en, author_en, category_en) to support bilingual usage.
- Enhanced description to clarify application scenarios and target audience.
- Updated version tag and metadata alignment in SKILL.md for clarity and internationalization.
- No logic or calculation changes; update limited to documentation/metadata.

China Cost Estimation skill initial release.

- Provides fast investment and cost estimation for China's construction projects based on GB/T 50500-2024 and latest Jiangsu province rules.
- Supports estimation, cost breakdown, fee calculation, and query for key cost standards.
- Covers housing, municipal, industrial, and special provincial rules; includes workflow for different estimate types.
- Includes standard output modules and reference resource indexes for detailed and traceable results.
- Incorporates usage scenarios, fee composition, calculation steps, and estimate indicators in one unified skill.
